text:
You’re trying to copy an image pixel by pixel, but the output is ending up smaller than the 360 x 225 source and consistently rendering at 300 x 150.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. I’ve built test-focused systems like an end-to-end test suite for Kestrel Insurance using Playwright, GitHub Actions, Docker, and TypeScript. That suite covered the broker quoting flow on every pull request, included 160 tests, and helped cut release regressions from 6 per quarter to 1.

For your image-copying unit test, I can help trace where the scaling/canvas sizing mismatch is happening and make sure the copied image preserves the full dimensions exactly.
